description: This file defines the EntityUniqueProperty class which implements validation logic to ensure a specific property value is unique for a given entity within the OrangeHRM system. It constructs database queries to check for existing entities with matching property values, considering options to trim input and match ignore or match values.

classes.name: EntityUniqueProperty
classes.description: A validation class that verifies the uniqueness of a property of an entity in the database, with options to handle trimming and matching/ignoring specific values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityUniqueProperty validator with the entity name, property, and optional matching options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check against the database to determine if the given input is unique for the specified entity property, considering matching and ignore options.
